heightPolicy: No measured DEM bundled in this detail pack; existing base shape and relief are not promoted into detail.

provenance.citation: NASA Uranus–Oberon 3-D resource, mosaicked with Voyager imagery; credit USGS/Tammy Becker and JPL/Caltech
provenance.coverage: Voyager 2 mapped approximately 40% of Oberon during the 1986 flyby; the official texture retains unmapped/black regions rather than inventing source imagery.
provenance.license: NASA/JPL/Caltech and USGS public mission imagery; retain attribution.
provenance.processing: Pinned 2048x1024 NASA WebP; resized without reprojection to 512x256, 1024x512 and native 2048x1024 JPEG derivatives; color is never used to derive height.
provenance.proceduralHeight: Seamless direction-vector field, little-endian uint16, height = -160 + sample x 0.5 m; bounded range is recorded per level; synthetic approximation only.

processing: Pixel-centered canonical east-positive imagery sampled bilinearly at native resolution (maximum 64 ppd); 512-pixel bounded JPEG tiles; 70-degree stereographic polar replacement, square equatorial ground spacing; little-endian uint16 scientific heights in lossless gzip. Polar imagery remains limited by native polar observations/fill.
